name: Caqua Schtoria
source:
A visitor from another world, who came to earth in pursuit of the reincarnated Demon Lord after learning of his existence.
She seems to have noble lineage, but prefers to do things herself instead of relying on others.

Kaguya is a cheerful, but mild-mannered girl, who loves pampering others.
She's a little on the mischievous side, though, and sometimes plays tricks on her friends just to get a reaction out of them.

She's really enjoying her life in Japan, and finds the culture and lifestyle very exciting.
Careful around her animal ears, they're very sensitive!

[From [url=https://twitter.com/NekoNyanSoft/status/1600924262562664448]NekoNyan's official Twitter[/url]]
